# The Purple Movement

> The Purple Movement connects young people, experienced professionals, institutions and communities to learn, collaborate and turn ideas into measurable action. Red stands for the energy of youth, blue for the experience of professionals; together, purple. Its three pillars are Beyond Borders, Beyond Gatekeepers and Beyond Syllabus.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://purple-movement.com/): what the movement does, activities, impact, legacy and how to join.
- [The Manifesto](https://purple-movement.com/manifesto): "We are the Manifestors of Change." The movement's founding text.
- [Join the Movement](https://purple-movement.com/join): a four-step form for individuals, organizations and government partners. Anonymous participation is possible.
- [Privacy notice](https://purple-movement.com/privacy) and [Terms of use](https://purple-movement.com/terms).

## Activities

- [Rise Together 2026](https://risetogether2026.com/): 18 November 2026, Park Centre, Technopark Phase 1, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. Convened by The Purple Movement. Brings government, industry, academia, startups, communities and young people together to connect existing capabilities into collaborative pilots, reviewed at 30, 90 and 180 days.
- [Beyond Syllabus (Bridge The Gap 4.0)](https://capabilitycommons.com/): a six-month journey on the future of education, August 2026 to January 2027, with a public archive called Capability Commons.
- [AI + Compassion Global Forum 2026](https://compassionai.io/): a 24-hour global relay across 12 world regions, held 2–3 October 2026 from Kyoto.
- Domain and campus chapters in the ":80" format, such as PRN:80, STI:80 and AEC&B:80 (2025). Each has a page under https://purple-movement.com/activities/.

## Legacy

The movement builds on FAYA:80 (read "FAYA port 80"), a free monthly technology gathering at Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram, from 5 June 2013 to its final edition, Beyond FAYA:80, on 28 June 2025. Archive: https://www.fayaport80.com/
